text: Would you like to restart Fallout now?

text: This setting has no effect while in Basic Graphics Mode.
source_text: This setting has no effect while in Basic Graphics Mode.

text: PRESS A KEY or ESC to cancel.
source_text: PRESS A KEY or ESC to cancel.

text: Setup the Screen Resolution, Colour mode and Refresh Rate for FullScreen Mode.
source_text: Setup the Screen Resolution, Colour mode and Refresh Rate for FullScreen Mode.

text: Setup the Fullscreen Colour output here.
source_text: Setup the Fullscreen Colour output here.

text: Setup the Fullscreen Refresh Rate here. Set this to '0' for the driver default setting.
source_text: Setup the Fullscreen Refresh Rate here. Set this to '0' for the driver default setting.

text: Customize the Fullscreen Width by clicking the number box.
source_text: Customize the Fullscreen Width by clicking the number box.

text: Customize the Fullscreen Height by clicking the number box.
source_text: Customize the Fullscreen Height by clicking the number box.

text: In Window Mode, this is the key you will hold down when using the mouse to scroll the Game and World maps.
source_text: In Window Mode, this is the key you will hold down when using the mouse to scroll the Game and World maps.

text: Press the red button to select a different key. Or click the number box to edit the Windows Virtual key code.
source_text: Press the red button to select a different key. Or click the number box to edit the Windows Virtual key code.

text: The name of the currently selected key.
source_text: The name of the currently selected key.

text: Enable X2 scaling. This will also up the min res to 1280x960. With Window mode requiring more space for its frame.
source_text: Enable X2 scaling. This will also up the min res to 1280x960. With Window mode requiring more space for its frame.

text: Enable or Disable Fog Of War. For best results this should be enabled before entering a map for the first time.
source_text: Enable or Disable Fog Of War. For best results this should be enabled before entering a map for the first time.

text: Adjust the light level and the Mouse 'look at' visibility of floors, walls and scenery under the fog.
source_text: Adjust the light level and the Mouse 'look at' visibility of floors, walls and scenery under the fog.

text: Floors, walls and scenery will always be visible and Mouse "look at" will function normally.
source_text: Floors, walls and scenery will always be visible and Mouse "look at" will function normally.

text: Floors, walls and scenery will be darkened and unresponsive to Mouse "look at" until discovered.
source_text: Floors, walls and scenery will be darkened and unresponsive to Mouse "look at" until discovered.

text: When enabled, scrolling away from the Player Character is unlimited. This works well if Fog Of War enabled.
source_text: When enabled, scrolling away from the Player Character is unlimited. This works well if Fog Of War enabled.

text: Increase the number of search nodes to extend the path finding distance. 20 levels in 2000 node increments.
source_text: Increase the number of search nodes to extend the path finding distance. 20 levels in 2000 node increments.

text: 2000 path search nodes (original value). Note: Each level requires an additional 156.25 KB of memory.
source_text: 2000 path search nodes (original value). Note: Each level requires an additional 156.25 KB of memory.

text: 40 000 path search nodes. Note: requires 3200000 bytes (3125 KB) of memory.
source_text: 40 000 path search nodes. Note: requires 3200000 bytes (3125 KB) of memory.

text: Stretched to fill the screen. Note: A space will remain at the bottom of the screen if subtitles are enabled.
source_text: Stretched to fill the screen. Note: A space will remain at the bottom of the screen if subtitles are enabled.
